{"metadata":{"description":"Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI, tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision.","id":"gh:1339579889","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-notebook","slug":"beihzb/dsh-notebook","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","ipykernel","ipynb","jupyter","notebook","python","vscode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Native Jupyter-style notebook for DeepSeek Harness: real ipykernel sidecar + VS Code-aligned cell UI"},{"id":"p1s2","text":", tqdm progress, inline figures, per-cell AI revision."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @beihaizb/dsh-notebook"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A stateful, Agent-controllable Jupyter workspace for DeepSeek Harness.** A persistent `ipykernel` "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"runtime that your DSH agent can read, edit, execute, and inspect — turning a notebook from a static "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"artifact into an operationable target."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This is not just another Notebook frontend. The kernel is **truly persistent** (variables live acros"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"s cells), the notebook **saves and reloads**, and the agent has **tools** that read, modify, run, an"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"d reason about cells and their outputs. That combination gives the agent a real **Agent ↔ Kernel ↔ A"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"cells and their outputs. That combination gives the agent a real **Agent ↔ Kernel ↔ Artifact** loop."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Agent workflow"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The point of this plugin is that the DSH agent doesn't run one-shot scripts — it drives a live compu"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" plugin is that the DSH agent doesn't run one-shot scripts — it drives a live computational session:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> User: *"Switch Harmony integration to scVI."*
> → Agent finds the relevant cell → reads its source"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" and context → edits the cell → executes it → checks stdout / traceback → iterates if needed."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Because the kernel is persistent, the agent is operating on stateful runtime state (an `Anndata`, a "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"GPU model, loaded data), not just assembling strings."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Screenshots / Demo"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Live **tqdm progress bars** and inline figures with click-to-zoom.
- **Clickable traceback** frame"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"s (`Cell In[N]`) that jump to the offending cell.
- Per-cell **"hand to AI"** revision box: type a r"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"equest, the agent edits and reruns that cell.
- VS Code-aligned cell behavior (queued / executing st"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ates, execution semantics)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Features (implemented)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Real persistent kernel**: `ipykernel` + `jupyter_client` sidecar — variables persist across cell"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s. **R kernels** (`IRkernel`) are supported too, picked from the same dropdown.
- **Agent tools** to"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" read, edit, run, and inspect cells (`nb_get`, `nb_edit_cell`, `nb_run_cell`, ...) with structured a"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ccess to outputs and tracebacks.
- **Runtime introspection for agents (safety-first)**: `nb_context`"},{"id":"p13s5","text":", `nb_list_vars`, and `nb_inspect_object` expose live kernel variables and compact notebook state, b"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ut **never call `repr()` on an arbitrary object**. `nb_list_vars` returns name, exact type, and shap"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"e only, with `pattern` filtering and `offset`/`limit` paging (default 100, max 200, `max_chars` boun"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ds the payload); `nb_inspect_object` returns type/shape by default and only a bounded preview when `"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"preview=true` is passed **and** the object is an allowlisted exact type (builtin containers and scal"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"ars, NumPy arrays, pandas `DataFrame`/`Series`, scipy sparse matrices, `AnnData` shape/`isbacked`). "},{"id":"p13s11","text":"Unknown types stay metadata-only. With no kernel running it answers `not_started` (**it will not sta"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"rt one just to look at variables**); while a cell is executing it answers `busy` (**it will not queu"},{"id":"p13s13","text":"e behind or ahead of your code**), and a probe timeout never interrupts your cell.
- **Safe AI edit "},{"id":"p13s14","text":"loop**: rich per-cell version snapshots, `nb_cell_history`, `nb_revert_cell`, `nb_error_context`, an"},{"id":"p13s15","text":"d `nb_edit_and_run_cell` support auditable repair-and-rerun workflows.
- **VS Code-aligned cell UI**"},{"id":"p13s16","text":": circular run control, `Queued` / `Executing` status bar, execution-number glyph.
- **VS Code-align"},{"id":"p13s17","text":"ed execution semantics**: Restart keeps completed outputs, Interrupt stops only the current cell, Ru"},{"id":"p13s18","text":"n All stops on error, plus Clear Outputs and Restart & Clear.
- **tqdm progress bars**, **long-outpu"},{"id":"p13s19","text":"t folding**, **multi-image grid**.
- **Error navigation** (click traceback to jump to the cell).
- *"},{"id":"p13s20","text":"*Resilient frontend**: a React error boundary keeps the notebook view alive instead of going blank w"},{"id":"p13s21","text":"hen an output fails to render (fixed a hooks-order crash that could blank the panel).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The trajectory is toward a full **agent computational workspace**, not more Notebook UI:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **AnnData / scientific object introspection** — extend `nb_inspect_object("adata")` with `n_obs`, "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"layers, `obsm`, and `obs` / `var` column summaries.
- **Execution history / diff UI** — expose audit"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"able cell versions in the browser, not just in tools / `cell.metadata.dsh` (per-execution records ar"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"e already collected).
- **Context-aware cell selection** — layer / query which cells define or depen"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"d on a variable, instead of stuffing the whole notebook into context.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Supported DSH runtime lines: `0.1.x-rc` and `0.2.0-rc`, verified against `0.1.7-rc.2` and `0.2.0-rc."},{"id":"p18s2","text":"2` (the plugin declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools: ^0.1.0-rc.6 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`). DSH refuses to boot a"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" plugin whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges exclude the running version and skips the whole bundle"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" — on an untested newer line, grant an exact-version exemption (`dsh plugin allow-version`, or the p"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"lugin manager) instead of forcing it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Kernel requirements"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Kernel | Needs |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Python | `ipykernel` **and** `jupyter_client` — the first runs the kernel, the second runs the sid"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ecar that talks to it |
| R | `IRkernel` in that R's library; nothing Python-side (the sidecar is bo"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rrowed from a Python env, preferring your `dsh-envsel` python) |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`nbformat` is **not** required — notebook files are read and written with the standard library."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`jupyter_client` and `ipykernel` are genuinely third-party protocol implementations, so a missing on"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e is reported with the exact install command instead of a raw `ModuleNotFoundError`; the kernel drop"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"down also marks such environments as unavailable rather than letting you pick a kernel that cannot s"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"also marks such environments as unavailable rather than letting you pick a kernel that cannot start."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**R kernels are opt-in**: opening a fresh notebook never silently starts R. Use the kernel dropdown "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"(`R · ggtree`, `R · hdWGCNA`, …) for an R notebook. Every entry is labelled with its language — `py "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"· scRNAv2`, `R · ggtree` — so the two are never confused, and `nb_kernel_list` reports the same `lan"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"guage` field (`"python"` / `"r"`). An environment that only has a Python interpreter but additionall"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"y ships R (very common in conda) is still reported in the runtime context by `dsh-envsel`, so the ag"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ent knows both invocations."}],"truncated":true}
